milestones.text: Share one belt with a Splitter
milestones.tip:
A Splitter shares a belt: belt logs in,
then lay two belts out to two buildings.

milestones.title: Village
milestones.tip:
More cottages need more bricks and planks.
Add pits, kilns and a second lumber camp.

One kiln makes about 12 a minute.
Tap Rates to see where you are.

Each kiln needs 2 clay pits and some logs.
Split a log belt to feed two kilns.

Split the sawmill's belt: one way to the
yard, one way to a Storage Crate.

A sawmill makes about 30 if its logs keep
coming. Trace it if it slows down.

milestones.title: Town
milestones.tip:
A second Builder's Yard builds homes in
another corner of the map.

Split your brick and plank belts so both
yards get a share.

Four busy kilns. Look for a kiln that is
waiting and Trace it.

milestones.title: Market Town
milestones.tip:
The whole map is yours. Keep every
belt moving.
